TR-MCP-FEDERATION-006.title: hub control table and polling contract
TR-MCP-FEDERATION-006.body: SyncSubscription key=(NodeId,ProjectId,Branch) contains HubEpoch UUID, PublishedHead, PublishedGeneration int64, DesiredGeneration int64, ReportedGeneration int64, WorkerEpoch int64, AcceptedHead, Outcome and timestamps. POST control/poll is read-only. POST control/report includes all epochs and observed generation; stale worker=409 stale_worker_epoch, stale hub=409 hub_epoch_changed. Poll every30s with20% jitter; commit/reconnect/on-demand wake immediately. Backoff1s doubling to60s. Generation ordering is valid only within HubEpoch. Restore generates a new non-reused random epoch before listeners reopen.
